name: Loll
author: E. T. Carter
description: A warm lit field with big soft shadows rolling slowly across it — like sunlight through drifting cloud, the brightest glow held off-centre while broad dark lobes sweep over and cool the tone as they pass. Calm, golden, unhurried.

params.label: Roll speed
params.effect: How fast the shadows roll across the field; 0 holds them still.

params.label: Shadow depth
params.effect: How dark and cool the rolling shadows get; 0 leaves an even lit field.

params.label: Shadow size
params.effect: Size of the drifting shadow lobes; low breaks into smaller patches, high into broad sweeps.

params.label: Distortion
params.effect: Organic distortion of the shadow edges; low is smooth, high adds billowing folds.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls the shadows toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
